desktop.title: Desktop
desktop.heading: How do you want to go back?
desktop.now.title: Go to the desktop just for now
desktop.now.text: The console closes and you see the Windows desktop.
desktop.now.boots: When you turn it back on, the console shows up again.
desktop.normal.title: Go back to normal Windows mode
desktop.normal.already: Windows already starts on its usual desktop. Only the console will close.
desktop.normal.text: On startup, Windows will open its normal desktop. The console stays in the Start menu.
desktop.foot: To use the console at startup again: open it from the Start menu → Settings → Startup.
